newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: VEDIOR'S ABILIS BUYS CLEANING FIRM.
newsitem.headline: VEDIOR'S ABILIS BUYS CLEANING FIRM.

text.p: Dutch temporary employment agency Vedior NV said on Monday its cleaning services unit Abilis plans to acquire Reiter Schoonmaakorganisatie BV, based in Maastricht.
Reiter, also a cleaning services company, has a turnover of some 10 million guilders and is active in the southern province of Limburg. Financial details were not disclosed.
Vedior said the takeover would have a slight positive effect on the results of Abilis in the 1997/98 financial year.
Abilis International had an annual turnover of 1.3 billion guilders in 1996.
